title: Veeran Hui Dunya
body:
abbas ke marne se tooti hai kamar sheh ki
veeran hui dunya akbar tere marne se
<<DIVIDER>>
kya tujhko khabar akbar jo guzri hai maadar par
ek barchi ka phal tere seene may utarne se
veeran hui dunya...
<<DIVIDER>>
aajate thay pehle to tum ek sada par hi
aate nahi ab maa ke faryad bhi karne se
veeran hui dunya...
<<DIVIDER>>
kis haal may sughra ko tum chod gaye akbar
fursat hi nahi milti aahein usay bharne se
veeran hui dunya...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab dekha sar e akbar laila ne kaha ro kar
ay kaash mai mar jaati pehle tere marne se
veeran hui dunya...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya dard ka aalam hai har laash tadapti hai
maa behno ke beparda maqtal se guzarne se
veeran hui dunya...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek laasha taraayi may uth'ta kabhi girta tha
shabbir ke maqtal may uthne kabhi girna se
veeran hui dunya...
<<DIVIDER>>
beenayi chini sheh ki izhaar sar e maqtal
hamshakle payambar ke dunya se guzarne se
veeran hui dunya...
author: Ali Izhaar
